subject.title: feat(feishu): bot-to-bot conversation support with @mention handling

question: Should Feishu preserve omitted allowBots as bot-authored traffic accepted by default, or require explicit opt-in for bot-authored messages before this PR lands?
rationale: The PR intentionally preserves the current Feishu admission behavior while adding loop protection, but this is a new operator-visible config/default surface and differs from sibling channel defaults.

options.title: Preserve Current Admission
options.body: Keep omitted allowBots accepting bot-authored Feishu messages and rely on the new loop guard for upgrade safety.

options.title: Require Explicit Opt-In
options.body: Change the default so bot-authored Feishu messages are ignored unless allowBots is set to true or "mentions".

options.title: Default To Mentions Only
options.body: Admit bot-authored Feishu messages only when the receiving bot is explicitly mentioned by default.

recommendation.title: Preserve Current Admission
recommendation.body: Keep omitted allowBots accepting bot-authored Feishu messages and rely on the new loop guard for upgrade safety.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has recent merged work on the exact Feishu mention delivery surfaces and is the strongest code-history routing candidate.
